mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous collapse of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES at t-0w signals a mobility-suppressing shock that persists for at least two weeks, reducing weekday footfall and pushing RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 20 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds its mean over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT falling more than 20 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in RESIDENTIAL above baseline indicates households are spending more time at home, which cuts discretionary retail trips and keeps RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is higher than its last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above +2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A GROCERY_PHARM reading above +5.0 marks a stock-up phase; once pantry loading is complete, displaced spending returns to retail and lifts RETAIL_REC above its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days remains below its last-28-day mean after GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +5.0.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS falling below zero after a positive run indicates outdoor trips are being curtailed by weather or restrictions; displaced activity shifts to indoor retail venues and raises RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 14 days fails to exceed its last-28-day mean after PARKS crosses below 0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint collapse of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES creates a negative commuting feedback loop: fewer workplace trips reduce daytime foot traffic, which depresses RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is higher than its last-28-day mean when TRANSIT is below -20 and WORKPLACES is below -10.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises above +5.0 while TRANSIT falls below -20, a stay-at-home policy regime is active; this combination suppresses retail trips and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds its last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL is above +5.0 and TRANSIT is below -20.

mechanism_narrative: A negative PARKS reading at t-0w signals a seasonal shift away from outdoor recreation; consumers reallocate leisure time and spending to indoor retail, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 14 days is lower than its last-28-day mean when PARKS is below 0.

mechanism_narrative: An extreme RETAIL_REC drop below -20 marks panic avoidance; after the initial shock, baseline shopping needs force a rebound, so RETAIL_REC next week exceeds its last-28-day mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the next week remains below its last-28-day mean after a reading below -20.
